Class ChaosPlanMapper

java.lang.Object
com.macstab.chaos.jvm.startup.ChaosPlanMapper
public final class ChaosPlanMapper extends Object
Jackson-based serialisation bridge between JSON and ChaosPlan.

The mapper is configured for strict parsing:

  • DeserializationFeature.FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES — rejects unexpected fields
  • DeserializationFeature.FAIL_ON_TRAILING_TOKENS — rejects JSON with trailing garbage
  • StreamReadFeature.STRICT_DUPLICATE_DETECTION — rejects a property given twice instead of keeping the last value
  • no coercion: a number is not a boolean, a string or a fraction is not an integer, a number or a boolean is not a string, and an enum is read by name only
  • a value given twice in a set (operations) is refused instead of being dropped
  • durations and instants are ISO-8601 strings only ("PT0.1S", "2026-11-01T08:00:00Z"); a number is refused (Jackson's own deserializers read one as seconds whatever their leniency)
  • StreamReadConstraints — caps nesting depth and single-string length at the streaming parser level; a pathological payload like "[[[[...]]]]...] }} cannot exhaust the stack or allocate an arbitrarily large String before the outer size gate sees it
  • a gate needs maxBlock: nothing can release a gate read from JSON, since its author holds no ChaosActivationHandle

Input size is validated before parsing to prevent OOM from oversized payloads. Durations and instants are written in ISO-8601; write(ChaosPlan) leaves out absent (null) values.

    • MAX_JSON_LENGTH

      @Internal public static final int MAX_JSON_LENGTH
      Maximum JSON input size accepted by read(String), in UTF-8 bytes: 1 MiB. Also the cap on a plan file and on a plan posted to a management endpoint.

  • Method Details

    • read

      public static ChaosPlan read(String json)
      Deserialises a plan, a single scenario or an array of scenarios, recognised by the JSON's structure: an object with a scenarios, metadata or observability member is a plan, another object a scenario. Scenarios are wrapped in a plan named "default". A leading byte order mark is skipped.
      Parameters:
      json - non-null JSON representation of a chaos plan
      Returns:
      validated ChaosPlan instance
      Throws:
      ConfigLoadException - if the JSON is malformed, exceeds size limits, or violates the plan contract

    • write

      public static String write(ChaosPlan plan)
      Serialises a ChaosPlan to a pretty-printed JSON string, leaving out absent values.
      Parameters:
      plan - non-null plan to serialise
      Returns:
      JSON representation
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if serialisation fails (indicates a bug)

    • readPlanOrScenarios

      public static ChaosPlan readPlanOrScenarios(String json, String planName)
      Reads a plan, a single scenario or an array of scenarios as read(String) does, wrapping bare scenarios in a plan named planName.
      Parameters:
      json - the JSON
      planName - the name of the plan wrapping bare scenarios
      Returns:
      the plan
      Throws:
